subject: Workplace Skills
title: The Email You Weren't Copied On
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Email You Weren't Copied On.

hook.text: She discovered a key decision through a forwarded thread she was never included on. It stung.

buildup.text: Being excluded from communication channels is a signal. It may be accidental, or very intentional.

discovery.text: Track patterns, not incidents. One omission is a mistake. Three in a month is marginalization.

twist.text: Address it directly and without accusation: 'I noticed I wasn't on the thread. Should I be involved?'

climax.text: Build enough relationships that missing one channel doesn't leave you blind. Diversify your info sources.

punchline.text: Being left out once is noise. A pattern is a signal.

quiz.question: How should you respond to being excluded from a key communication?
options: Assume it's intentional and confront the person publicly
Track patterns and address it directly without accusation
Start excluding them from your communications in return
